openwrt_git_ath79.Titel: ath79: add support for TP-Link CPE510-v2/v3
openwrt_git_ath79.Text: outdoor wireless CPE for 5 GHz with one Ethernet port based on Atheros AR9344; Based on the same underlying hardware as the TP-Link CPE510; Power, LAN, and 4 green LEDs; 1 10/100Mbps Shielded Ethernet Port (Passive PoE in); Built-in 13dBi 2x2 dual-polarized directional MIMO antenna; Adjustable transmission power from 0 to 23dBm/200mw
openwrt_git_ath79.Flashing: factory image über Stock-WebUI oder TFTP; Reset beim Einschalten 4-5 s halten; recovery.bin; TFTP-Server 192.168.0.100, Gerät 192.168.0.254
openwrt_git_ath79.DTS: compatible tplink,cpe510-v2 / qca,ar9344; LEDs lan GPIO11, link1-4 GPIO13-16 (link4 = System-LED), reset GPIO4 KEY_RESTART; SPI-NOR jedec 25 MHz; Partitionen u-boot 0x0-0x20000, partition-table, info 0x30000 (MAC @0x08), firmware 0x40000+0x780000, config 0x7c0000, art 0x7f0000 (Kalibrierung @0x1000); eth0 MII an swphy4
openwrt_git_ath79.Image: Device/tplink_cpe510-v2: ATH_SOC ar9344, IMAGE_SIZE 7680k, DEVICE_PACKAGES rssileds, TPLINK_BOARD_ID CPE510V2, okli-Loader @0x43000, SUPPORTED_DEVICES cpe510-v2
openwrt_git_ath79.Safeloader: CPE510V2 vendor CPE510(TP-LINK|UN|N300-5):2.0; SupportList EU/UN/US mit Suffix 00000000/45550000/55530000 sowie ohne Suffix, jeweils :2.0

openwrt_git_ar71xx.Titel: ar71xx: add support for TP-LINK CPE510 V2.0

openwrt_git_ar71xx_fix.Titel: ar71xx: improve support for TP-Link CPE510 v2
openwrt_git_ar71xx_fix.Text: Device support for the CPE510v2 so far has been a hack to enable flashing with CPE510v1 images. Those even have different hardware (e.g. additional ethernet port). With this patch, we provide proper support for this device in ar71xx.
openwrt_git_ar71xx_fix.Installation: wie ath79-Commit: WebUI oder TFTP, Reset 4-5 s, recovery.bin, 192.168.0.100/192.168.0.254
openwrt_git_ar71xx_fix.mach: cpe510_v2_setup: PHY4-Switch ohne Swap, LEDs wie cpe210_v2, LAN-Port eth0 über phy4 MII, MAC aus 0x1f830008, WMAC-Kalibrierung 0x1fff1000; Profil cpe510-v2 BOARDNAME CPE510V2

openwrt_dts.ar9344_tplink_cpe510-v2.dts: #include ar9344_tplink_cpe_1port.dtsi; compatible tplink,cpe510-v2, qca,ar9344; model TP-Link CPE510 v2

openwrt_dts.ar9344_tplink_cpe.dtsi: label-mac-device = wmac; reset GPIO4 KEY_RESTART; ref 40 MHz; SPI jedec,spi-nor 25 MHz; u-boot, partition-table, info (macaddr @0x8), firmware 0x40000/0x780000 (openwrt,uimage OKLI, Offset 0x3000), config, art (calibration @0x1000, 0x440); eth0 phy-handle swphy4; LNA-GPIO 18 und 19 als gpio-hog high
